name: Kinetic Proficiency
body:
Prerequisite(s): Devastating infusion, kinetic blade, or kinetic fist; Weapon Focus (kinetic blast).

Benefit(s): You can use infusions which are normally used as part of an attack action as part of a coup de grace, disarm, sunder, or trip attempt.

Normal: You can only use these blasts as part of an attack action, full-attack action, or charge.
